name: Glass DM inbox
oneLiner: an inbox on a glass pane: four direct messages land one by one at the top, each pushing the others down with an unread dot and the count badge ticking up, then a pointer taps the newest and the thread slides open with the full message
say: when the speaker says the messages started pouring in ('my DMs blew up', 'people kept asking me how'): the rows land as they say it, the thread opens on the one they quote
